title: hasApiResponse is a third copy of "loaded" beside the read relay's and the erase machine's, and it also gates saves
evidence: Done 2026-11-14: the erase machine owns the first read. EraseCommon gains read: 'pending' | 'shown' | 'failed'; phase is 'idle' | 'erasing' (lib/erase-machine.ts); the loaded event carries shown, and moves read once, in either phase. useErase exposes loaded = read === 'shown', the one gate these five read: useProfileSave, useOnboarding, hasUnsavedLongitudinal, InputPanel autoSaveGate, BloodTestTimeline saveDisabledByLoad (the lab upload's handleSaveLongitudinal and useListSaves never read it, before or after: not changed here). useRecordApply.firstReadShown dispatches loaded{shown:true} then relay.loaded(), called where loadData set hasApiResponse; firstReadFailed sends shown:false. One intended change (rule R2): after this tab's erase ends before the first read shows, read stays pending, so a remote erase arriving then waits for the first read; and an erase heard in that window, read at the own-end or own-failed, is read once more at loaded (one extra read, no second count: erase-machine.test.ts). Pins: erase-machine.test.ts (L2 H37, Q3 H37, H37 R2 rows), useErase.test.tsx, useRecordApply.erase.test.tsx (H37 R2 path), HealthTool.record-read-pins.test.tsx (US-34 AC4: saves stay off after a part-way failure). Was: widget-src/src/components/HealthTool.tsx:105 useState(false), set after await mirrorRecord, passed as loaded to useRecordApply, whose layout effect dispatched the machine's loaded and relay.loaded(); D1 a failed read left it false while the machine went idle; D2 an own erase in the window went loading -> erasing -> idle with it still false.
